proposition_text: These Regulations may be cited as the Reduction and Prevention of Agricultural Diffuse Pollution (England) Regulations 2018.
notes: judit_extraction_meta:{"evidence_quote": "may be cited as the Reduction and Prevention of Agricultural Diffuse Pollution (England) Regulations 2018"}

proposition_text: These Regulations come into force on 2 April 2018.
These Regulations extend to England and Wales.
These Regulations apply to agricultural land in England.
